transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I wanted to get ahead of next Friday's planned Atlas toolkit release. As we all know, I can't record final legal approval until every pre-release condition from open-source, commercial, export-control, and privacy counsel is completed and documented. Can I get a status update from each of you on where your respective checklist items stand? I want to make sure we have enough runway to address any outstanding issues before Friday.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Elena, I need to flag a significant open-source compliance issue before you record any approval. While reviewing the build manifest this week, I confirmed that the public distribution links the Atlas toolkit with a GPLv3 library. This means the combined distribution must use the GPLv3 license and include corresponding source and attribution notices. I have not yet updated the release ticket with this finding, so my open-source checklist item is not complete. Given that this condition remains outstanding, the release approval should be recorded as false until we resolve the GPLv3 obligations.
